rules.name: "Drokk Me, it's Dredd!!!"
rules.description:
Whenever Dredd activates, he can immediately attempt to intimidate all opposing models that are within 12", without using an action. No characters are immune to this effect.

To determine the effect of the intimidation, take a Cool test for each model. If the test is failed the target model is pinned.

rules.name: Gaze in to the Fist of Dredd
rules.description:
Dredd is subject to the Brawler rule.
When a model with the Brawler skill successfully dodges or rolls a [Special] result on its Resist roll against a close combat attack, it may counter-attack by striking back.

rules.name: Incredible Shot
rules.description:
Aimed Fire double-action is classed as a single action for Dredd.
May not be used more than once in the same turn (second must be a Snapshot).
This skill allows Dredd to shoot an Aimed Fire only weapon and perform another single action in the same activation.

rules.name: Indestructable
rules.description: Judge Dredd suffers no stat losses for injury or stun results the he suffers. The only way to put him down is to incapacitate or subdue him.

rules.name: Brawler
rules.description: When a model with the Brawler skill successfully dodges or rolls a [Special] result on its Resist roll against a close combat attack, it may counter-attack by striking back.

All Justice Department models are subject to the Respect the Law rule when facing SJS Judges.
When a SJS Judge activates they can immediately attempt to intimidate any Justice Department models that are within 12", without using an action.
To determine the effect of the intimidation, take a Cool test for each model. If the test is failed the target model is pinned.

rules.name: Intimidate
rules.description:
Whenever Grice activates, he can immediately attempt ot intimidate all opposing models that are within line of sight and within 8" range of him, without using an action. To determine the effect of the intimidation, make a Cool test for Grice. If the test is passed, one model within range is pinned for each [Special] Result rolled.
Justice Department memebers are immune to these effects.

rules.name: Respiratore
rules.description:
Due to his surgical modifications to adapt to Tiatan's toxic atmosphere, Grice always counts as being equipped with a respirator.
Stumm Gas weapons have no effect on this model.

rules.name: Martial Arts Master
rules.description:
Orlok the Assasin is one of the few people capable of fighting Judge Dredd to a standstill. He has the Brawler skill.
Additionaly, when attempting to Dodge in close combat, Orlok may roll 5 Evade dice.

rules.name: Drokk-Satelat!
rules.description: Orlok was often accompanied upon his missions by an advanced Satellat war surveillance drone that he cleverly used to distract opponents. Once per game Orlok may declare an automatically successful Dodge against one shooting attack even if he fails his normal Dodge attempt. This will trigger the Gunfighter rules to shoot back as appropriate.

rules.name: Indestructable
rules.description: Orlok suffers no stat losses for injury or stun results the he suffers. The only way to put him down is to incapacitate or subdue him.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: I'll Go Up to 4 on the Chump!!!, Izzat So!, 4 1/2

rules.name: I'll Go Up to 4 on the Chump!!!
rules.description:
Mean Macines Fight and Shoot stat depend on his dial setting, the base stats are at his calmest:
1 Surly = Shoot 3, Fight1		
2 Mean = Shoot 2, Fight 2	
3 Vicious = Shoot 1, Fight 3
4 Brutal = Shoo 0, Fight 4
Mean's dial can be set when he activates as a free action, on setting 4, Mean Machine suffers no stat losses for Injury or Stun markers on him. The only way you stop Mean on 4 is to incapacitate him or subdue him.

rules.name: Izzat So!
rules.description: Mean has no fear of any opponent and is therefore completely immune to the Intimidate, Respect the Law, and "Drokk Me, it's Dredd!!!" skills.

If Mean Machine is on dial setting 4 and takes one or more injury or stun results from a single attack then roll one Combat die.
[Special] rolled = Mean's mood dial is knocked up to 4 1/2.
Make an immediate free Charge double-action directly toward the model that inflicted that result.
Once on 4 1/2, Mean Machine can no longer change his dial setting and is limited to taking Sprint, Charge or Fight actions.
He will attack the closest model regardless of faction from now on until he is incapacitated or subdued.

rules.name: BOK!!!
rules.description: When performing a Charge double-action, roll two D6's when determining the additional distance moved. Take the highest value and add it to Mean's Move. Mean Machine will also add +3 Power to a Charge close combat attack rather than the normal+1.

rules.name: Angel of Mercy
rules.description: if Oola begins an activation within 3" of any subdued or incapacitated character, she must move within 1" and use the Hunker Down double-action to deliver a fatal injection. If successful, the target character is immediately euthanised and becomes the property of Resyk. They are Permanently eliminated from the game, and if playing a campaing, these characters do not roll a Resist test to see if they return.

rules.name: Under the Radar
rules.description: Anytime a character wishes to attack Oola in range or close combat they must make a Cool test. if they fail the attack does not happen and the action(s) are wasted.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: Angel of Mercy, Brawler, Under the Radar

rules.name: Lethal
rules.description:
Any injuries inflicted by a weapon with the Lethal rule cannot be removed with the Hunker Down double-action. They also cannot be removed with a Med-Pack Armoury card or by any character using the Combat Medic rule.
Cannot harm robots or vehicles.

rules.name: Fly Like an Eagle
rules.description: Homer's enchance attributes of his custom Bat glider are built in to his stat line. Homer is always assumed to be airborne and using the Grav trait during movement. Additionaly is not affected by forcible dismounts.

rules.name: Homer's Eggs
rules.description:
Homer has the special ability to accurately drop smoke bombs rather than throw them. At any one point during Homer's move, whether a Move or a Sprint action, you may place a convenient Smoke marker up to 1" away from the model. After Homer's activation has completed, models may not trace a line of sight for ranged attacks if they pass within 3" of that Smoke marker.
The effect of the Smoke Bomb remain until the end of the game tunr it was used in. Remove the Smoke markers from the tabletop when you collect up Action chips.
This ability has not limit and requires no Armoury cards.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: Fly Like an Eagle, Homer's Eggs

rules.name: Jet Barf
rules.description:
Once per game, a Fattie with this rule may perform an Aimed Fire double-action to spray nearby enemies with a concentrated stream of corrosive vomit!
All models caught within the blast will be automatically pinned unless successfully dodged.

rules.name: Wall of Flub!
rules.description:
When making a Charge roll use 2D6 but do not add the model's Move.
-The Fattie must move the full distance rolled.
-If a Fattie moves in to close combat range (1") of a target it makes a close combat attack with a bonus of +2 to its Fight.
-Target model gains +1 to Evade Dodge, whatever the result of the attack the target is diplaced 1" out of the Fattie's path.

rules.name: BeliWheel Skills
rules.description:
Porker statline includes +2" Move and +1 Evade from his cutom BeliWheel.
When Dick rolls for his Wall of Flub! Charge distance roll 3D6 instead of 2D6.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: BeliWheel Skills, Jet Barf!, Wall of Flub!

rules.name: Robot Control
rules.description: When Narcos is activated he can use one or both of his actions to allow any friendly robot that has already activated to perform a bonus single action. If he uses both actions to two different robots. However, no single robot can be given two actions.

rules.name: Self-Repair Sub-Routines
rules.description: Ner's body is capable of rapid and highly effective self-repairs. If Narcos is injured and uses the Hunker Down double action, it can potentially remove all injury markers if enough successes are rolled.

rules.name: Who Needs Frendz
rules.description: If Nero is the leader of your faction then after both factions have drawn their Armoury cards, you may randomly pikc and discard one of your opponent's Armoury cards.

rules.name: Don't Push It!
rules.description: When performing an Aimed Fire double-action, Fats Hambo can make up to three separate ranged attacks. However, he does not receive the Aimed Fire bonus to Shoot or Power if he does so.

rules.name: Wall of Flub!
rules.description: Fats Hambo follows the rules on page 106 of the Judge Dredd Miniatures Game rule book.

rules.name: Just Eat It!
rules.description: Fats Hambo can use a Hunker Down double-action to remove Injury or Stun markers from himself. Roll a Resist test. For each [ARMOUR] result one Injury or Stun marker may be removed. Fats Hambo cannot do this if he is incapacitated or subdued.
